items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Linton. I met Linton in later years when Linton was an accompanist for Timmy Rogers.

ctx.x: now. Where are we? We were in Pittsburgh. (inaudible). How about Linton Garner?

I didn't know Linton. I met Linton in later years when Linton was an accompanist for Timmy Rogers. Linton was a very good pianist also, but I didn't -- Billy Strayhorn used to talk about Linton because they were friends.
